definition: [ קָטֹן , Lag BN 26.31 ] verb be small, insignificant (Late Hebrew Hiph`il and derivatives, Syriac ; Old Aramaic קטין insignificant ; Arabic parum edens ; Ethiopic be thin , chiefly in derivatives; probably also Assyrian ku‰‰innu , small , younger , Zehnpf BAS i.505 (otherwise Xl HWB323 ); Meissn Suppl. †atânu , be short (of hair), compare Bez ZA viii, 141 f. ); — Qal Perfect 1 singular קָטֹנְתִּי Gen 32:11 , with מִן compare, I am too insignificant for all the kindnesses; Imperfect 3 feminine singular וַתִּקְמַן זֹאת בְּעֵינֶיךָ 2Sam 7:19 = 1Chr 17:17 . Hiph`il literally Infinitive construct לְהַקְטִין Amos 8:5 making ephah small .
